arguments.command:
# Remove the namespace finalizer to unstick argo-events
NS_JSON=$(kubectl get ns argo-events -o json 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$NS_JSON" ]; then
  echo "$NS_JSON" | jq 'del(.spec.finalizers[])' | kubectl replace ns argo-events --raw "/api/v1/namespaces/argo-events/finalize" -f - 2>&1
fi

# Force delete remaining CRDs
for crd in eventbus.argoproj.io eventsources.argoproj.io; do
  kubectl delete crd "$crd" --force 2>&1 || echo "(already gone: $crd)"
done
